parts.name: Switch
parts.Basic_description: This is the switch or handle of a faucet, typically made of stainless steel for durability and corrosion resistance.
parts.Functional_description: It is used to control the water flow and temperature by rotating or lifting the handle.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate or tilt to open or close the water valve, allowing precise control of water output.

parts.name: Frame
parts.Basic_description: This is the frame or base of the faucet, usually made of brass for strength and resistance to corrosion.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the switch and connects to the water supply lines, ensuring a stable structure for the faucet.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and provides a fixed mounting point for the movable switch component.
